sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Balancing - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Right, now it's time to test some body armor. This is for the cleanup crew only. Let's see how it holds up against real mercs. Try killing a few PMCs while wearing this PACA armor. After that, I'll see what else I can come up with."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 2 PMC operatives while wearing a PACA Soft Armor on any location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +7,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.03
- 45 GP coins
  - 47 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Death Shadow mask
"Alive? Good! What, the armor's shit and doesn't hold against anything? Well shit, that's a shame. It'll be too weak for the cleanup crew, so I'll have to find a better model. Here's your reward. Let's finish with this balancing thing for now."
